behavior: The signed-in app is a working money dashboard: header, grouped sidebar, personal balance chart, business overview, transactions page and a phone home
acceptance: Desktop: grouped sidebar (profile switcher without the wallet address, pages by profile type, Soon items, the account menu, which holds the app's one Dark mode switch on desktop and phones) and a header with breadcrumb, ⌘K search (pages, profiles, transactions), notifications from received transfers, Receive and Send (disabled with reason); content edges line up with the header (same side padding, no centered maximum width). Phones: top bar (account, search, notifications), bottom tabs Home, Transactions, Balances, Profiles

Totals across tokens show in USD (each stablecoin counted as 1 USD, marked as an estimate). Personal overview: total balance on the left and a balance-over-time line chart (GET balance-history, range tabs, crosshair tooltip, keyboard reachable) on the right over the Codex dawn/night banner (rows in docs/web/images.md), then recent transactions and balances by network; phone shows a centered balance with round actions and cards. Merchant and freelancer: a business overview with range tabs, KPI strip (balance, received, payments, pending), received-per-day bars, balance by network and a payments table with All/In/Out filter, search and CSV export

/app/transactions lists GET transactions with direction filter, search and Show more; Receive opens from any page; axe finds no serious or critical violation on desktop and phone in both themes; Playwright covers desktop and phone; built through Impeccable (direction contract, finish review, DESIGN.md) and an independent review; /kit opens in `next dev` without KIT_ENABLED and stays 404 in a production build without it; AGENTS.md says to write comments only where the code cannot say it; root `pnpm dev` also starts Postgres, the api and the worker, and Ctrl+C stops them all; the Receive sheet shows the token and network, a large QR code, the full address in one labeled box with its start and end marked, and one copy button
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: Checked: money (bigint for all shown amounts in balance-history, tokenTotal, CSV, business totals, hero Change; floats only in chart geometry and axis ticks; cents cut, never rounded up; USD estimates marked; no made-up 0; UTC day labels correct), query args carry profileId, polling, loading/error/empty states, payments 100+ logic (correct), command menu combobox/listbox with native dialog Escape and focus return, native radio SegmentedControl, chart keyboard + live region + hidden table, collapsed sidebar names, one theme control per viewport, disabled actions announce the reason, hidden phone/desktop twins are display:none, structure (no cross-feature private imports, ui-web additions on /kit), CSV guard, no innerHTML. Fixed: (1) BusinessOverview and NotificationsMenu showed the previous profile's figures and notifications after a switch between business profiles (RTK data keeps the last args' result): BusinessOverview keyed by profileId in dashboard-screen.tsx, notifications use currentData. (2) Payments-in count used a rolling days*24h window while Received uses UTC days with today included: since now starts at 00:00 UTC of the first history day. (3) CSV guard also covers leading tab and CR (OWASP), with a test. (4) Removed BALANCES_COPY.updated and .networks, left unused by this change. (5) Acceptance 3 asks for axe in both themes but the app was only checked in light: e2e now runs axe after the desktop and phone theme toggles; passes. Proof 3 text updated to match. Not fixed, minor: during a range change the hero Change and the Received figure show the old range's amount beside the new range name until the history loads; notification 'new' compares block time to the local open time, so a transfer recorded after opening with an earlier block time is never marked new (follow-up: remember seen keys); BALANCES_COPY.readAt and PROFILES_COPY.profileLabel were unused before this change. Ran: web test 28 passed, lint, typecheck, pnpm e2e (21 + 8 passed), verify F079 passed.
2026-10-10 F072 merged (PR #77). F079 app redesign verified and review passed, uncommitted on its branch for the owner's review; next: owner reviews, then commit + done F079

2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: Delta review (theme in account menu, shell padding, USD totals, comment cleanup, /kit in dev, tasks.json merge). Checked: apps/backend identical to origin/main; tasks.json F080/F081 equal to main, validate ok; ui-web Switch unchanged vs main (only MenuCheckboxItem added); one theme control (account menu, desktop and phone), sidebar has no switch; header and main both px-4 sm:px-6, no max width; usdTotal bigint at finest decimals, cut once to cents; series in USD cents from the API *Usd fields; no token-unit total left (symbols only on per-token rows); no made-up 0 (null -> dash or skeleton); removed comments were descriptive only, the money rules stay (cut once, no made-up 0, payments 100+ window, UTC day labels); e2e strengthened, not weakened; /kit 404 without KIT_ENABLED in a production build (kit.spec passes), NODE_ENV=development opens it in next dev. Fixed: (1) business overview USD figures had no estimate mark (acceptance 2, DESIGN.md): one muted line under the figure strip; (2) design.json: Menu Checkbox Item said dark mode on phones only, and the sidebar css kept an unused .ds-side-toggle rule. Not fixed: backend usd() uses big.Rat.FloatString(2), which rounds half up, so chart, Received and Change cents can be up to half a cent above the cut value and the chart's last point can differ by 1 cent from the hero total (backend is out of scope for F079; follow-up). Ran: web test 27 passed, lint, typecheck, docs-check 0 errors, pnpm e2e 21 + 8 passed, validate ok, verify F079 passed (8 checks).

2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: Delta review (root pnpm dev starts the backend, one-row sidebar top with collapse in the header, Receive sheet redesign, balance hero with estimate info button, Coming soon tooltips, DESIGN.md). Fixed: (1) SOON_ACTION_CLASSES lived in features/balances/money-actions.tsx but only the app-shell header uses it after the round-actions change: moved into app-header.tsx (D-11). (2) DESIGN.md and design.json still said desktop money actions are pills; now round on desktop and phones, the dashed pill is only the header Send. (3) e2e comment still said the address shows in groups. Not fixed, minor: Radix tooltips do not open on touch and the soon actions no longer have an onClick, so tapping Send/Transfer/Withdraw on a phone shows nothing (owner chose no notice text; reason stays for screen readers); dev.sh needs apps/backend/.env and Docker, and if the api exits the worker keeps running until Ctrl+C.
